sampling: first two lexicographic pairs per source and kind; no score or label filtering
qk_frozen: all layers final-token Q and K; original recipient prefix cache
ov: recipient attention weights with donor V on identical aligned token positions; unaligned values retained
routing: donor attention weights on identical aligned positions, recipient weights elsewhere, renormalized; recipient V
projection: donor minus recipient selected head output through layer-matched random O block, Frobenius norm matched
main_score: FP32 yes-minus-no; frozen E1 readout reported separately
historical_50_seed_random_experiments: reuse only; one new layer-matched control for missing E1 interventions
projection_native: same baseline donor-recipient delta added through native O blocks, matching projection_swap additive placement
